visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain views. Pale single western tower,three west Gothic window fields,steep red nave roof,lower polygonal eastern chancel,north/east chapels,southern vestibule,stepped outward buttresses and selected west pinnacles are present. Tower has four actual pointed belfry openings,clock/rose fields,green copper apron/rounded bulb,open octagonal lantern,tall spike,restrained golden ribs and abstract crown. Side doors/glazing have closed recessed backing. Corrected inward buttresses and their tapered steps,removed the window covered by the northern chapel,moved apse supports away from lancets and aligned metal/clock details to the model floor.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final Earth-lighting views: Economy/High,noon/late,three distances,silhouette,six details,four matched whole-model levels and four transitions. Italian-palazzo neighbors are synthetic context,not local map buildings.
